title.narrative: Support to FATF-Style Regional Bodies (FSRBs) in preparing for Mutual Evaluations

description.narrative: As a member of FATF Norway is expected to provide financial and technical support to FSRBs (FATF-Style Regional Bodies). The support is provided through the FATF secretariat, hosted by the OECD. The grant is counted as Norwegian support to the 4th round of Mutual Evaluations, and will contribute to the implementation of Strategic Priority 1 of FATF work plan; Strenghten the Global Network. The expected effect(s) on society are two-fold. On one hand, by improving the quality of FSRB MERs, the project will empower national authorities of ODA countries’ members of FSRBs, to strengthen their legal and institutional frameworks against money-laundering, and terrorist and proliferation financing and improve their effectiveness in the fight against financial crimes, by providing them with clear guidance and recommendations. On the other, the project will have a positive impact on development in ODA countries, by contributing to their financial integrity and curbing illicit financial flows.
